title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E10 — I'm a Sick Puppy
When a priest from Florida goes missing, police focus on a troubled ex-convict whom he helped support; through multiple interrogations, a psychopathic killer reveals details of a twisted vengeance that escalates to a chilling murder.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E01 — I Guess My Life Is Over Now
A mother who calls 911 to report her 32-year-old son is threatening her turns up dead in her home; he becomes the only suspect, and when he turns himself in, his pragmatic retelling of the slaying isn't just cold-hearted, it's psychopathic.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E04 — Heat Will Destroy
After his conviction for the brutal slaying of his wife, a Florida inmate lays claim to another unsolved murder 17 years prior, revealing that he's a manipulative psychopath with a history of violence and an unquenchable thirst for revenge.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E05 — Hell to Look Forward To
A man confesses to accidentally killing his best friend while cleaning his gun; during his interrogation, he stuns police by revealing that he's behind a long trail of bloodshed and is a serial killer who seems to consider himself an angel of mercy.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E03 — It Wanted to Kill Somebody
Searchers for a missing woman find her brutally beaten body in a dilapidated house near her home; the case goes cold until a local teen steps forward to reveal that he's the killer.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E09 — This is What I Chose to Be
Missing persons report leads police to a career criminal and his girlfriend; they uncover a twisted world of illicit schemes, macabre fantasies, and a puppet master manipulating young women down a dark path of sex, drugs and exploitation.

title: 48 Hours
description:
S39 E24 — Kimberly Langwell's Hidden Grave
When a mother vanishes, her daughter is desperate for answers; decades later, a secret grave solves the mystery.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E16 — Every Time Was Like Christmas
Between 1991 and 2001, several violent sexual assaults occur along I-85 between Wyoming and Utah; the cases remain cold until almost two decades later, when advancements in DNA technology lead detectives straight to a psychopathic sexual predator.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E17 — He Got Such a Rush From It
Police charge a son and his wife with the murder of his father until a tip comes from a woman claiming her ex-husband and his friend admitted to the brutal killing; detectives interview the new suspects and uncover a pair of cold-blooded psychopaths.

title: Toxic
description:
S02 E05 — The Chosen One
When a teenage girl in a tightly controlled religious community falls prey to her charismatic pastor, she's told it is love; years later, she realizes it is abuse and takes on those in the church who would rather destroy her than face the truth.

title: Lethally Blonde
description:
S02 E07 — Burlesque and Blood
When the torso of a murdered French Quarter dancer washes up on a Mississippi beach, a community is driven to panic; to catch her killer, detectives must dive into the dark side of New Orleans, uncovering a world of sex, cults and ritual sacrifice.

title: Who Killed Jane Doe?
description:
S01 E02 — Girl Gone West
A young woman's body is found in the Arizona desert, while over 2,500 miles away, a young man worries about his missing sister; an investigation into her death begins, and it will take decades to reveal her name and her killer.

title: Who Killed Jane Doe?
description:
S01 E01 — The Scarlett Doe
The body of a beautiful woman is found in the Pennsylvania woods at Christmastime, and it's clear her death is no accident; determined to discover the victim's name, officials launch an investigation that spans 10 years.

title: Disappeared
description:
S09 E02 — Last Words
Logan Schiendelman vanishes, and authorities find his car abandoned; multiple tips claim seeing Logan, but searches turn up nothing; with no evidence of foul play, questions surface and police are forced to examine his family's controversial past.

title: Disappeared
description:
S09 E09 — So Close to Home
Ali Lowizter, 16, vanishes after getting off her school bus; the investigation stalls for two years until a tip comes in claiming Lowizter could have been trafficked, leading to a SWAT team raid on a house of prostitution.

title: Disappeared
description:
S09 E12 — Moment of Truth
When 70-year-old retired firefighter Michael Chambers goes missing, a bloody crime scene in his garage indicates foul play; then, authorities begin to believe that the crime scene may have been staged.

title: Disappeared
description:
S09 E01 — Edge of Fourteen
Fun-loving 14-year-old Ashley Summers vanishes in 2007; the mystery deepens when the FBI connects her case to two other young women missing from her neighborhood.

title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
description:
S01 E05 — The Child I Thought I Knew
A single mother overcoming addiction struggles to raise her son and daughter; despite what appears to be a loving family and a sibling bond she could only hope for, she never could have foreseen the true monster that lies within her 13-year-old son.

title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
description:
S01 E01 — Drive To Kill
A mother notices that her son is dark and detached and occasionally reveals to her fantasies of violence towards his own family. She begins to wonder if her once-happy, sweet boy is evil, but could never imagine the true terror her son would become.

title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
description:
S01 E03 — I'm the Monster's Mother
Jeannette does everything she can to care for her son, Timmy; everything is going well until his dark side emerges, and he becomes violent and dangerous; despite every effort to help her son, she watches helplessly as he spirals into darkness.

title: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
description:
S01 E04 — The Sins of Our Son
When Tim Jones Jr. murdered his five children, his father, Tim Sr., was left to face the horrific reality of the son he raised and an evil he never believed possible.

title: American Monster
description:
S12 E08 — Lovely Rida
Matt Hendershot is devastated when his marriage ends and his ex-wife moves on; but following the death of her lover, he allows her back into his home, along with a collection of the dead man's guns; it is a mistake which will prove to be fatal.

title: American Monster
description:
S12 E06 — Love Is Deaf
When Christie meets Marcus in high school, they think they've found love's young dream; as the relationship becomes rocky, Christie begins to fear Marcus's violent tendencies; little does she know, all her fears will soon become a reality.

title: American Monster
description:
S12 E10 — Tempest
Vincent Taylor is stuck in a controlling relationship; a knife attack results in Vincent's death.

title: American Monster
description:
S12 E03 — I Love My Wife
Ann Metz lives for her family, particularly her two beautiful granddaughters; her husband Marshall despises Ann's giving her time to anyone but him, and he will go to desperate measures to keep hold of her.

title: American Monster
description:
S12 E01 — I Saw Dad Kill Mom
The lives of a beautiful young family in Long Beach, New York, rip apart when five-year-old Audrey witnesses her mother, Diane, brutally stabbed to death; to Audrey's horror, her mother's murderer is somebody very close to home.

title: American Monster
description:
S13 E07 — The Last Dance
After years of suffering in silence, Francisca Quintero finally leaves her violent husband, but for Javier Bahena, there is no such thing as a divorce; his wife has a choice: stay with him or die.

title: The Serial Killer Connection
description:
S01 E01 — Till Death Do Us Part
Kara Robinson Chamberlain relives her escape from a serial killer while Bonnie Lou reveals what it was like to be married to him.

title: The Serial Killer Connection
description:
S01 E02 — Behind Closed Doors
Following a serial killer's military postings, Bonnie and Kara investigate murders in Maine, possible victims in San Diego, and chilling evidence in Virginia suggesting the serial killer's crimes stretched far beyond those officially known.

title: A Body in the Basement
description:
S03 E02 — Her Last Steps
Days before Christmas, a suspected home invasion stuns a quiet Connecticut neighborhood, leaving a mother of two dead in the basement and her husband badly injured; investigators soon discover that this case may not be what it first appears.

description:
S01 E02 — Hidden Evil
Twenty-seven-year-old beauty Sherri Jackson vanishes, leaving behind a blood-smeared apartment; as investigators launch a frantic search for Sherri, they discover she was harboring a dark and violent secret that may have gotten her killed.

title: Dead Reckoning
description:
S01 E03 — A Killer Unveiled
A kind and well-liked husband and father, Tom Bragg, is found brutally murdered; his community struggles to think who wanted him dead.

title: Devil in the Web
description:
S01 E01 — Cyber-Stalker
Andy Castillo uses the internet to call and text female realtors in 20 different states; wielding their social media against them, he makes the women believe he's lurking nearby, adding to their terror.

title: Devil in the Web
description:
S01 E04 — Dangerous Game
Fourteen-year-old Aubrey Peal uses an app to find others interested in gaming; he strikes up an online friendship with a man named Jason, who claims he is suicidal; concerned, Aubrey agrees to meet Jason, not realizing his evil intentions.

title: Devil in the Web
description:
S01 E05 — Scammed On
CeCe bonds with a man she meets on a dating app, and she happily obliges when he asks her for money for his business, but she becomes yet another victim of a romance scam.

title: Devil in the Web
description:
S01 E03 — Reptile Cult
Online cult leader Sherry Shriner reaches her followers through YouTube videos and keeps them in line via her Facebook page; when a group member dies in a tragic shooting, attention turns to Sherry and the control she wields over her followers.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S04 E01 — People You May Know
Single mother Lorianna Parker meets good-looking Corey Davis online, and she is filled with hope as their friendship blossoms, but when she meets him in the flesh, her dream date turns into a living nightmare.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S04 E07 — Playing Doctor
Twenty-four-year-old Jessika Rovell falls for Jeffrey Marsalis' charm and good looks but when she discovers his secret online life as Dr. Jeff, she realizes she's been dating a monster who stalks dating sites.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S04 E06 — Love You to Death
Seventeen-year-old adoptee Chelsea Schobert feels out of place at home, then she finds acceptance with Shawn whom she meets online, but as their relationship develops, the whole family is drawn into a devastating series of events.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S04 E08 — Crime Scene Selfie
Twenty-three-year-old Amanda Taylor shares her entire life on the Internet, then a tragedy takes place, and her posts take a dark turn.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E01 — The Springfield Three
On June 6, 1992, Suzie Streeter and Stacy McCall attend parties celebrating their high school graduation; by morning, the teenagers have gone missing, along with Suzie's mother, Sherrill Levitt; the case leads police on a nationwide search.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E11 — Suburban Secrets
After doting mother Cheryl Coker vanishes from Riverside, Ohio, numerous searches turn up nothing; as police take a closer look at the case, they uncover some disturbing information.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E03 — Without a Trace
In San Francisco, Kevin Collins, 10, disappears on his way home, galvanizing the residents to find him; with few leads to go on, Kevin's case sheds light on hundreds of other children who have vanished without a trace in the United States.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E10 — Oklahoma Horror Story
Right before Thanksgiving, two masked gunmen reportedly invade a couple's home and kill the husband; with few leads, police use ballistics, forensics and neighborhood gossip to solve this cold-blooded murder.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E08 — Nine Years in the Shadows
In 1988, a young woman is found murdered in her Modesto, Calif., home, leading police to investigate the strife and infidelity in her marriage; a surprising witness eventually comes forward.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S04 E07 — Law & Murder
A double murder involving the family of a federal judge prompts an investigation of epic proportions by the FBI, U.S. Marshals and Chicago Police Department; at the end of the trail, law enforcement personnel learn the death count may climb higher.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S09 E11 — The Truth About Blair
Jennifer Brown, vanishes from her Limerick home and detectives race against the clock to find her. With her eight-year-old son asking where his mother is, investigators must confront a web of lies woven by the people she trusts the most.

title: Mean Girl Murders
description:
S03 E06 — Running for Her Life
A West Philadelphia neighborhood is left reeling when a high school track star, who had her eyes set on Olympic glory, disappears without a trace.

title: Hollywood Demons
description:
S02 E05 — Surviving 16 and Pregnant
Expecting teens met backlash after appearing on "16 and Pregnant"; sixteen years since the show's debut, cast members open up about the struggles they faced in its wake, including homelessness, addiction, an FBI raid, and insinuations of murder.

description:
S02 E01 — Carjack Chaos
In Florida, a carjacking sparks a police chase over land, air, and sea, with the suspect stealing multiple vehicles in a desperate bid to outrun the law.

title: High Speed Chase
description:
S02 E03 — AK on the Highway
Georgia police officers chase down two suspects with an assault rifle who are intent on shooting their way out of trouble; a terrifying life-or-death pursuit results in multiple casualties before the gunmen lead police into a final fatal gunfight.

title: High Speed Chase
description:
S02 E09 — This Is Going To Hurt
In Camden, Ga., a driver leads deputies on a 150-mph chase before a high-speed PIT brings the pursuit to an end; in rural Texas, a thief leads deputies down dusty roads, through water, and into the woods in the middle of the night.

title: High Speed Chase
description:
S02 E02 — Full Throttle
In Florida, a boat thief runs from the law, kicking off an adrenaline-fueled speedboat chase. A nighttime patrol shifts up a gear when a six-ton U-Haul suspected of harboring stolen goods is spotted.

title: Body Cam
description:
S02 E06 — On the Edge
Arkansas police stop a knifeman enraged over a midnight pot roast; in Delray Beach, Fla., officers must rescue two children teetering on a ledge with their mother who is high on drugs; in Utah, a trespasser attacks an officer with his own baton.

title: Body Cam
description:
S03 E10 — Race Against Time
Police break into an apartment to save the lives of two women as their machete-wielding attacker leads officers on a pursuit; in Wisconsin, a winter storm causes a multi vehicle pile-up.

title: Body Cam
description:
S03 E09 — Fight or Flight
Armed bank robbers are determined to avoid prison at all cost.

title: Body Cam
description:
S03 E07 — Moments From Death
SWAT is on the scene to temper a life-threatening domestic standoff.

title: Body Cam
description:
S03 E02 — Kidnapped
All police units try and catch the suspects who snatched a baby from the hands of its mother and return the child; an officer makes a routine traffic stop and ends up fighting for his life when he suffers a severe reaction.

title: Body Cam
description:
S03 E05 — In Harm's Way
An armed suspect fires at police before embarking on a pursuit; a man locks himself in his garage, but it catches fire, and police don't know if they're on a rescue mission or victims of an ambush.

title: See No Evil
description:
S10 E04 — Black Widow
In Groton, Vermont, a young man with a developmental disability leaves work and is never seen again; with no leads in sight, investigators must rely on surveillance footage to piece together the truth behind Christopher Gray's disappearance.

title: See No Evil
description:
S10 E01 — Ticket to Murder
In Dalton, Ga., someone stabs convenience store clerk Dahyabhai Kalidas Chaudhari to death at his job; police turn to security footage for answers and discover a surprise revelation about the killer's identity that blows the case wide open.

title: See No Evil
description:
S10 E08 — Comply or Die
In North Carolina, Stephanie Powell-Anderson's convenience store shift ends in bloodshed, as part of a larger pattern of violence plaguing the area; with the assailant growing bolder by the day, the heat is on to make an arrest before he kills again.

title: See No Evil
description:
S09 E07 — Final Offer
The police lack leads after single mom Laura Ackerson leaves for work one morning and never returns, so they turn to surveillance cameras to try to locate her and unearth sinister footage.

title: See No Evil
description:
S09 E03 — Making A Killing
Michelle Mockbee arrives at work early in order to get ahead on payroll, and she is murdered outside her office less than an hour later; detectives follow the surveillance footage to a closet full of dirty secrets.

title: See No Evil
description:
S09 E06 — Shaken and Disturbed
In Alexandria, Va., Nancy Dunning, Ronald Kirby and Ruthanne Lodato are all fatally shot in broad daylight by a gunman knocking at the front door; detectives attempt to use security footage to track down the killer before they strike again.

title: See No Evil
description:
S13 E06 — Like a Brother to Me
When police find 27-year-old Corey Lee Hughes dying on his kitchen floor, they turn to security video to find his attacker; a neighbor's camera captures a suspicious SUV leaving the scene; investigators follow the clues to track down its driver.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S10 E08 — Death on Robinswood Lane
In Arkansas, 47-year-old Mario Miller turns up dead in a stranger's driveway; as detectives trace his last hours, a chilling conspiracy is revealed.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective
description:
S06 E07 — Catfished to Kill
Detective Ryan Jorstad follows a digital trail of evidence after police find a man shot and robbed in his own truck; as he uncovers a series of messages, he reveals a perpetrator who will stop at nothing to protect his identity.

title: Killer Confessions: Case Files of a Texas Ranger
description:
S01 E05 — Obstacles to Justice
Detectives investigate the murder of 20-year-old Joseph Douglas, shot execution style in Texas; when leads stall and rumors swirl, his mother turns to Texas Ranger Jim Holland, who reopens the cold case to pry loose the truth from guarded suspects.

When Asia Adams' body is discovered after a fire in her home, police are unsure if her death was an accident or arson; when the investigation reveals the truly horrific nature of her murder, police find themselves pursuing an elusive killer.
